**Type:** implementation. **Priority:** P1. **Capability:** `volume-automation`.
**Formats:** gp3, gp4, gp5, gp6, gp7, gp8. **Stages to assess:** export.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Preserve two non-default values at different positions and their linear flags.

Run `ALPHATAB_CONFORMANCE=1 go test -count=1 -v -run '^(TestGP8|TestAlphaTab)VolumeConsumerLimits$' .`
